NORMAL.cause: All monitored sensor parameters are within normal operating ranges.

BEARING_FAULT.cause: Abnormally high machine vibration indicates a possible bearing problem.
BEARING_FAULT.recommendation: Inspect bearing condition, lubrication and shaft alignment.

OVERLOAD.cause: Excessive current indicates that the machine may be operating under excessive load.
OVERLOAD.recommendation: Reduce machine load and inspect the motor and connected load.

VOLTAGE_FAULT.cause: Supply voltage is outside the normal operating range.
VOLTAGE_FAULT.recommendation: Inspect the power supply, wiring and voltage regulation.

PRESSURE_FAULT.cause: Machine pressure is outside the normal operating range.
PRESSURE_FAULT.recommendation: Inspect the pressure system, valves and connections.
